ruleDefinitions.name: HackTool - Default PowerSploit/Empire Scheduled Task Creation
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the creation of a schtask via PowerSploit or Empire Default Configuration.

sequences.query: ((parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$")) AND process_path = RGX("\\\\schtasks\\\.exe$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/Create.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*powershell\\\.exe\\ \\-NonI.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/TN\\ Updater\\ \\/TR.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/SC\\ ONLOGON.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/SC\\ DAILY\\ \\/ST.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/SC\\ ONIDLE.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/SC\\ HOURLY.*")))
